messages:
support-ops: heads up - Nimbus (APAC) reporting sharp p99 API latency jump since ~10:20 UTC. p95 ~540ms -> p99 ~2.9s on generate calls. sample req: req_8f3a. customer sees occasional timeouts.

customer-success: forwarded customer logs, they show long TLS handshake times and repeated TCP retransmits.

alex-net: grabbing edge egress metrics now. seeing a spike in egress queue depth on apac-pop-3 at 10:18 UTC, BGP neighbor 203.0.113.7 shows increased retransmit rates. p95 conn setup ~120ms, p99 conn setup ~1.8s.

maya-sre: @alex-net can you paste traceroute and SNI distribution? suspect peering partner instability.

alex-net: traceroute from apac-pop-3 to 198.51.100.23 (customer) 10:22 UTC:
```
traceroute to 198.51.100.23 (198.51.100.23), 30 hops max
 1 10.0.0.1 0.45 ms
 2 203.0.113.1 1.2 ms
 3 203.0.113.7 45.8 ms  <-- peer
 4 198.51.100.23 46.3 ms
```

alex-net: tcpdump on apac-pop-3 around 10:20 shows repeated TLS ClientHello retransmits and handshake reattempts:
```
10:20:15.123 IP apac-pop-3 > 198.51.100.23: Flags [S], seq 0
10:20:15.125 IP 198.51.100.23 > apac-pop-3: Flags [S.], ack 1
10:20:15.400 IP apac-pop-3 > 198.51.100.23: Flags [S], seq 0  (retransmit)
10:20:16.500 IP apac-pop-3 > 198.51.100.23: TLS ClientHello
10:20:18.900 IP apac-pop-3 > 198.51.100.23: TLS ClientHello (retransmit)
```

jing-infra: eBPF traces show envoy worker threads experiencing kernel-level socket queueing; drop at the egress socket queue limit contributing to delayed handshake processing.

samir-platform: any infra/config change around 10:15?
deploy-bot: release 2026.03.16-0820 applied to edge-pop-apac: small route-policy update.

maya-sre: hypothesis: new egress preference caused traffic to shift to peer-B (203.0.113.7) which is intermittently dropping packets -> handshake retransmits -> queueing. short-term: de-preference peer-B and shift to peer-A.

alex-net: applying BGP policy change: de-preference 203.0.113.7 for apac-pop-3 (10:44 UTC). draining conn to peer-B.

opsbot: runbook action executed: egress reweight applied to apac-pop-3. alert suppressed.

alex-net: metrics update: p99 fell from 2.9s -> 420ms within ~3 minutes after reroute. egress queue depths returned to baseline. tcp retransmits reduced.

customer-success: Nimbus confirms improvement and no more timeouts. :tada:

maya-sre: mitigation is egress de-preference. next steps: open ticket with peer-B NOC (203net) and request their connection logs + route flap history. add synthetic TLS-handshake probe per-POP and auto-deweight runbook action.

samir-platform: filing follow-up INC: INC-20260316-042 to track partner escalation and long-term routing fix.

maya-sre: marking thread resolved. will draft a short postmortem and tighten alert hysteresis to avoid flip-flop. thanks all.
